title: TreeCalc corpus workspace fixture
description: A shared multi-node tree fixture referenced by resolution cases. node_id is the canonical dotted path (the node identity surface). Sibling order is the array order.

node_id.description: Canonical dotted path = node identity. Intermediate ancestors must also appear as nodes.

formula.description: Node content (single field). Empty string = node-level Empty value; leading '=' = formula; otherwise a literal constant (number/logical/text per Excel cell-entry rules, CORE_MODEL_SPEC §6). Formula evaluation cannot produce top-level Empty; ="" is an empty string text value.

is_meta.description: When true, this node and its descendant subtree are invisible to formula resolution and not bound/evaluated (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §2, §6 item 9).
